# Panel Bay

> Count panels, posts, Postcrete bags and gravel boards for one fence run.

Panel Bay is a UK fence tally for one run. The tally runs in the browser, with no accounts. Panel Bay does not give planning advice.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.panelbay.co.uk/): fence tally
- [Height](https://www.panelbay.co.uk/height/): where to read fence height rules
